name: mangle-type-handle
instr:
I'm restoring type handling in our Go copy of Mangle so programs can check structured facts against declared bounds and inclusion constraints. Could you fill in the remaining implementations, including the parsing and fact-store support used with those checks?

The repository is at `/app`. The type-handle entry point is `symbols.NewTypeHandle` in `symbols/symbols.go`, with related stubs in `symbols/typeexprs.go`. The other panicking stubs are in `builtin/builtin.go` and `engine/inclusioncheck.go` for fact checks, `parse/parse.go` and `parse/gen/mangle_parser.go` for map and struct parsing, and `factstore/factstore.go` and `factstore/simplecolumn.go` for merging and loading facts.

The API doc comments are the contract; follow them alongside the surrounding code and `README.md`'s description of Mangle and its optional type checking. Custom name-prefix bounds exclude the prefix itself. Keep the existing public names and signatures so callers continue to work; private helpers are up to you. I'll run the project's own tests for these features, and the rest of the module's tests must keep passing.

Use text Go files with paths requiring neither whitespace nor Git quoting; add no symlinks or binary Go diffs. In added non-test code, avoid: new `init()` functions; the `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys/unix`, `golang.org/x/sys/windows`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `runtime/trace`, `testing` and `flag` packages; dot imports of `os`, `runtime`,
